marketSummary: US equities posted modest gains across the board, with small-caps leading (IWM +1.45%) and tech/growth stocks advancing solidly (QQQ +1.30%, SPY +1.13%), suggesting risk-on sentiment despite gold weakness. Divergent sector performance reflects selective positioning around quantum computing, hospitality headwinds, and restructuring opportunities. The broad-based rally masks underlying sectoral volatility tied to geopolitical tensions and consumer spending pressures.
